user.title: My Water Advisor
user.description: Sign in with the email and password you use on mywateradvisor2.com. Hourly usage is imported as long-term statistics for the Energy dashboard.

data.unit: Unit your portal reports usage in
data.backfill_days: Days of history to import on first setup

data_description.unit: Values are not converted. Pick the unit shown on your portal's usage chart.
data_description.backfill_days: Up to 365. Larger values make the first import take longer.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-enter your My Water Advisor password
reauth_confirm.description: The portal rejected the saved password for {email}.

error.invalid_auth: The portal rejected the email or password.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the My Water Advisor portal. Try again later.
error.no_meters: Signed in, but no meters are linked to this account.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. Check the Home Assistant log.
error.login_refused: The portal refused the login. Check the password; if it is correct, the account may be temporarily locked. Wait an hour before trying again.

abort.already_configured: This account is already set up.

data_description.poll_hours: 1 to 24 hours. The portal posts readings in batches, often a day late, and locks accounts that sign in too often, so a few hours is plenty.
data_description.hour_label: Compare a day with the portal's Hourly chart. Changing this only affects newly imported hours; remove and re-add the integration to re-import history.
